name: Shared-Attribute Clustering
description: Links infrastructure nodes that share a registrar, nameserver, ASN or TLS certificate, using data already in the graph.

plugins.name: Shared-Attribute Clustering
plugins.description: Links nodes that share a registrar or nameserver (Domain), announcing ASN (IP Address) or SHA-256 fingerprint (Certificate), using the selected nodes or, with no selection, the whole graph. Edges are labelled "shared registrar: <value>", "shared nameserver: <value>", "same ASN: <value>" or "shared certificate: <value>"; values shared by more than 30 nodes are skipped and existing edges are not duplicated. Uses only data already on the nodes.
